text: あったり　まえ　だけどさ…　とり　ポケモンは　じしん　や　じわれ　には　つよいよ

structure.jp: あったり　まえ　だけどさ…
じしん　や　じわれ　には

patterns.name: 〜に強い
patterns.span: じわれ　には　つよい
patterns.explanation: に つよい says what something holds up well against. じしん や じわれ には つよい = 'strong against Earthquake and Fissure'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but', and here it softens what he is about to say; さ is a casual filler. あったり まえ だけどさ = 'it's obvious, but, you know'.
